name: Synthesis and Reactions of Heterocycles and Biomolecules
description: Nomenclature of Heterocyclic ring systems, Structure, reactivity and synthesis of reduced three membered Heterocycles:Oxiranes, Thiirane and Aziridine; reduced four membered Heterocycles: Oxetane, Thietane, Azetine; five-membered Heterocycles with one hetero atom: Pyrrole, Thiophene, Furan; five membered Heterocycles with two hetero atom: Pyrazole, Imidazole, Oxazole, Thiazole; reduced Six membered Heterocycles, Pyridine, heterynes, pyridones, N-oxides; Aromatic heterocyclics Indole, Quinoline and Isoquinoline, Coumarins and Chromones, Introduction to carbohydrates; common protecting groups and protecting group strategies; glycosylation, amino acids, solid phase peptide synthesis, Nucleic acids.
